params.name: currency
params.description: Only return transactions in a certain currency. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. items.docs:
Returns a list of transactions that have contributed to the Stripe account balance (e.g., charges, transfers, and so forth). The transactions are returned in sorted order, with the most recent transactions appearing first.

Note that this endpoint was previously called “Balance history” and used the path /v1/balance/history.
